## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!dice` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --orange: #ff8a3d; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --soft: #5b4a86; --die: min(21vw, 84px); }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--sky) 0%, var(--mint) 100%); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 14px 14px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  main { height: 100%; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
  h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; }
  .badge { flex: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
  .toggle { flex: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); }
  .toggle button { min-height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 800 15px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }
  .toggle button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .35); }

  .stage { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .25); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
  .stage:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .stage[hidden] { display: none; }
  .tray { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: min(4vw, 16px); height: calc(var(--die) + 22px); }
  .die { position: relative; display: block; flex: none; width: var(--die); height: var(--die); border-radius: 22%; border: 3px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ink); background: var(--c); }
  .die i { position: absolute; width: 19%; height: 19%; margin: -9.5% 0 0 -9.5%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); visibility: hidden; }
  .die i.on { visibility: visible; }
  .die b { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: calc(var(--die) * .5); font-weight: 800; }
  .die.tumble { animation: tumble .28s linear infinite; }
  .die.land { animation: land .35s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.7, .5, 1); }
  @keyframes tumble { 0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-12px) rotate(180deg); } 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes land { from { transform: scale(.75); } to { transform: scale(1); } }
  .label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--soft); }
  .big { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .sum { min-height: 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  .coinbox { display: block; width: 124px; height: 124px; perspective: 600px; flex: none; }
  .coinbox.toss { animation: toss 1.1s ease-in-out; }
  @keyframes toss { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } 45% { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.08); } }
  .coin { display: block; position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .3, 1); }
  .face { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid var(--ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; backface-visibility: hidden; -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px rgba(255, 255, 255, .45); }
  .face strong { font-size: 50px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; }
  .face span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; }
  .heads { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ffe39a, var(--yellow) 55%, var(--orange)); }
  .tails { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #b8f5e3, var(--mint) 55%, var(--sky)); transform: rotateY(180deg); }
  .tally { display: block; width: min(100%, 260px); }
  .bar { display: flex; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: #e7ddf5; margin-top: 4px; }
  .bar i { display: block; height: 100%; transition: width .4s ease; }
  #barH { background: var(--orange); }
  #barT { background: var(--sky); }
  .counts { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  .controls { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
  .controls[hidden] { display: none; }
  .step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); }
  .step button, .ghost { min-width: 40px; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 800 20px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .3); cursor: pointer; }
  .step button:disabled { opacity: .4; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; }
  .step output { min-width: 50px; text-align: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .ghost { padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14px; }
  .primary { flex: 1; max-width: 190px; min-height: 46px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pink); color: var(--ink); font: 800 17px system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #b8245a; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s, box-shadow .1s; }
  .primary:active, .step button:active, .ghost:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #b8245a; }
  .primary:disabled { cursor: default; }
  .note { flex: none; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .die.tumble, .die.land, .coinbox.toss { animation: none; }
    .coin, .bar i { transition: none; }
  }
</style>
<main>
  <header>
    <h1>Dice &amp; coin</h1>
    <span class="badge">🎲 Random</span>
  </header>
  <div class="toggle" role="group" aria-label="Mode">
    <button type="button" id="modeDice" aria-pressed="true">🎲 Dice</button>
    <button type="button" id="modeCoin" aria-pressed="false">🪙 Coin</button>
  </div>

  <button type="button" class="stage" id="diceStage" aria-label="Roll the dice">
    <span class="tray" id="tray"></span>
    <span class="label" id="totalLabel">Total</span>
    <span class="big" id="total">?</span>
    <span class="sum" id="faces">Tap to roll</span>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="stage" id="coinStage" aria-label="Flip the coin" hidden>
    <span class="coinbox" id="coinbox"><span class="coin" id="coin"><span class="face heads"><strong>H</strong><span>HEADS</span></span><span class="face tails"><strong>T</strong><span>TAILS</span></span></span></span>
    <span class="sum" id="coinResult">Tap to flip</span>
    <span class="tally">
      <span class="counts"><span id="countH">Heads 0</span><span id="countT">Tails 0</span></span>
      <span class="bar" aria-hidden="true"><i id="barH" style="width: 50%"></i><i id="barT" style="width: 50%"></i></span>
    </span>
  </button>

  <div class="controls" id="diceControls">
    <div class="step">
      <button type="button" id="less" aria-label="Fewer dice">−</button>
      <output id="count">2 dice</output>
      <button type="button" id="more" aria-label="More dice">+</button>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="primary" id="roll">Roll</button>
  </div>
  <div class="controls" id="coinControls" hidden>
    <button type="button" class="ghost" id="reset">Reset tally</button>
    <button type="button" class="primary" id="flip">Flip</button>
  </div>
  <p class="note" id="note">Random: every face has the same chance.</p>
  <div id="live" aria-live="polite" style="position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%)"></div>
</main>
<script>
  var TEXT = { tapRoll: 'Tap to roll', tapFlip: 'Tap to flip', rolling: 'Rolling…', flipping: 'Flipping…', total: 'Total', rolled: 'You rolled', dice: ' dice', die: ' die', heads: 'Heads', tails: 'Tails', flips: ' flips', diceNote: 'Random: every face has the same chance.', coinNote: 'Random: heads and tails have the same chance.' };
  var DIE_COLORS = ['#ff4f8b', '#ffc93c', '#9be15d'];
  // Pip cells on a 3×3 grid, numbered 0–8 left to right, top to bottom.
  var PIPS = { 1: [4], 2: [2, 6], 3: [2, 4, 6], 4: [0, 2, 6, 8], 5: [0, 2, 4, 6, 8], 6: [0, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8] };
  var MAX_DICE = 3;

  // Unbiased integer in [0, n): rejects the top slice of the 32-bit range that would skew the modulo.
  function randInt(n) {
    var limit = Math.floor(4294967296 / n) * n, buf = new Uint32Array(1);
    if (!window.crypto || !crypto.getRandomValues) return Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
    do { crypto.getRandomValues(buf); } while (buf[0] >= limit);
    return buf[0] % n;
  }

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  var calm = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var diceCount = 2, dice = [], busy = false, heads = 0, tails = 0, angle = 0;

  function makeDie(i) {
    var d = document.createElement('span');
    d.className = 'die';
    d.style.setProperty('--c', DIE_COLORS[i % DIE_COLORS.length]);
    for (var k = 0; k < 9; k++) {
      var pip = document.createElement('i');
      pip.style.left = (24 + (k % 3) * 26) + '%';
      pip.style.top = (24 + Math.floor(k / 3) * 26) + '%';
      d.appendChild(pip);
    }
    var q = document.createElement('b');
    q.textContent = '?';
    d.appendChild(q);
    return d;
  }

  function showFace(d, value) {
    var cells = d.getElementsByTagName('i'), on = value ? PIPS[value] : [];
    for (var k = 0; k < 9; k++) cells[k].className = on.indexOf(k) >= 0 ? 'on' : '';
    d.lastChild.textContent = value ? '' : '?';
  }

  function buildDice() {
    var tray = $('tray');
    tray.textContent = '';
    dice = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < diceCount; i++) {
      var d = makeDie(i);
      tray.appendChild(d);
      dice.push(d);
    }
    $('count').textContent = diceCount + (diceCount === 1 ? TEXT.die : TEXT.dice);
    $('less').disabled = diceCount <= 1;
    $('more').disabled = diceCount >= MAX_DICE;
    $('total').textContent = '?';
    $('totalLabel').textContent = TEXT.total;
    $('faces').textContent = TEXT.tapRoll;
  }

  function roll() {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;
    $('roll').disabled = true;
    var values = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < diceCount; i++) values.push(randInt(6) + 1);
    var total = values.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
    function finish() {
      for (var j = 0; j < dice.length; j++) {
        dice[j].classList.remove('tumble');
        showFace(dice[j], values[j]);
        dice[j].setAttribute('aria-label', 'Die ' + (j + 1) + ': ' + values[j]);
        if (!calm) { dice[j].classList.remove('land'); void dice[j].offsetWidth; dice[j].classList.add('land'); }
      }
      $('total').textContent = String(total);
      $('faces').textContent = diceCount > 1 ? values.join(' + ') : TEXT.rolled + ' ' + values[0];
      $('live').textContent = diceCount > 1 ? 'Rolled ' + values.join(', ') + '. Total ' + total : TEXT.rolled + ' ' + total;
      busy = false;
      $('roll').disabled = false;
      $('roll').textContent = 'Roll again';
    }
    if (calm) { finish(); return; }
    $('total').textContent = '…';
    $('faces').textContent = TEXT.rolling;
    // The shuffling faces are decoration only; the result was drawn above before any animation.
    var ticks = 0;
    for (var k = 0; k < dice.length; k++) dice[k].classList.add('tumble');
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      for (var m = 0; m < dice.length; m++) showFace(dice[m], randInt(6) + 1);
      if (++ticks >= 9) { clearInterval(timer); finish(); }
    }, 75);
  }

  function renderTally() {
    var n = heads + tails;
    $('countH').textContent = TEXT.heads + ' ' + heads;
    $('countT').textContent = TEXT.tails + ' ' + tails;
    $('barH').style.width = (n ? heads / n * 100 : 50) + '%';
    $('barT').style.width = (n ? tails / n * 100 : 50) + '%';
  }

  function flip() {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;
    $('flip').disabled = true;
    var isHeads = randInt(2) === 0;
    // Always turn forward: at least one full turn past the current face, five when animated.
    var base = angle - (angle % 360) + (calm ? 360 : 1800);
    angle = base + (isHeads ? 0 : 180);
    $('coin').style.transform = 'rotateY(' + angle + 'deg)';
    $('coinResult').textContent = TEXT.flipping;
    var box = $('coinbox');
    if (!calm) { box.classList.remove('toss'); void box.offsetWidth; box.classList.add('toss'); }
    function done() {
      if (isHeads) heads++; else tails++;
      var word = isHeads ? TEXT.heads : TEXT.tails;
      $('coinResult').textContent = word + '! · ' + (heads + tails) + ((heads + tails) === 1 ? ' flip' : TEXT.flips);
      $('live').textContent = word + '. Heads ' + heads + ', tails ' + tails;
      renderTally();
      busy = false;
      $('flip').disabled = false;
      $('flip').textContent = 'Flip again';
    }
    if (calm) done(); else setTimeout(done, 1100);
  }

  function setMode(coin) {
    if (busy) return;
    $('modeDice').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!coin));
    $('modeCoin').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(coin));
    $('diceStage').hidden = coin;
    $('diceControls').hidden = coin;
    $('coinStage').hidden = !coin;
    $('coinControls').hidden = !coin;
    $('note').textContent = coin ? TEXT.coinNote : TEXT.diceNote;
  }

  $('modeDice').addEventListener('click', function () { setMode(false); });
  $('modeCoin').addEventListener('click', function () { setMode(true); });
  $('diceStage').addEventListener('click', roll);
  $('roll').addEventListener('click', roll);
  $('coinStage').addEventListener('click', flip);
  $('flip').addEventListener('click', flip);
  $('less').addEventListener('click', function () { if (!busy && diceCount > 1) { diceCount--; buildDice(); $('roll').textContent = 'Roll'; } });
  $('more').addEventListener('click', function () { if (!busy && diceCount < MAX_DICE) { diceCount++; buildDice(); $('roll').textContent = 'Roll'; } });
  $('reset').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (busy) return;
    heads = 0; tails = 0;
    renderTally();
    $('coinResult').textContent = TEXT.tapFlip;
    $('flip').textContent = 'Flip';
    $('live').textContent = 'Tally reset';
  });

  buildDice();
  renderTally();
</script>
`

client.command('dice', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Dice & coin",
    height: 420,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The dice and coin flipper opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
    bypassDownload: false,
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 420 px |
| Size | 14.5 KB |
| Input | Tap |
| Download prompt | May appear on some accounts: `bypassDownload: false` keeps the card from reloading and losing its state |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
